# Lawrence Totimeh Jr. (Agent Kodak)

> Lawrence Totimeh Jr., known online as Agent Kodak (@AgentKodak), is a social justice advocate, civic educator and U.S. Army combat veteran who served in Iraq. He is based in the Washington, D.C. area. Through his School of Law series he teaches how the justice system works in plain language, from the public record, so everyday people know their rights and can hold public officials accountable. He is a TEDx speaker (TEDxSinkor, Monrovia, Liberia). He is an educator, not an attorney.

"Agent Kodak" is Lawrence Totimeh Jr. It is not related to the Eastman Kodak company.
